description: This file contains macro definitions and inline functions related to radio hardware control for Nordic Semiconductor's nRF51 series, including timing parameters, power levels, and mode configurations.

methods.name: hal_radio_reset
methods.description: Resets or initializes the radio hardware settings.

methods.name: hal_radio_stop
methods.description: Stops radio operations and performs cleanup.

methods.name: hal_radio_phy_mode_get
methods.description: Returns the radio PHY mode based on input parameters.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_power_min_get
methods.description: Returns the minimum transmit power level.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_power_max_get
methods.description: Returns the maximum transmit power level.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_power_floor
methods.description: Determines the closest supported transmit power level for a given level.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_ready_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns delay in microseconds for radio transmit readiness.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_ready_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns delay in microseconds for radio receive readiness.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_chain_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns chain delay in microseconds for transmission.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_chain_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns chain delay in microseconds for reception.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_ready_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns delay in nanoseconds for radio transmit readiness.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_ready_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns delay in nanoseconds for radio receive readiness.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_chain_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns chain delay in nanoseconds for transmission.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_chain_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns chain delay in nanoseconds for reception.
